[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended brands for athletic socks include Nike, ASICS, Under Armour, Smartwool, Balega, and ExOfficio.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Balega socks provide arch support, cushioning, and moisture-wicking properties.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] ExOfficio socks are designed for high-performance activities with features like arch support and quick-drying materials.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] When choosing a brand, consider personal preferences, type of activity, and budget.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Nike offers socks specifically designed for tennis, including Nike Court Flex Tennis Socks, Nike Pro Tennis Socks, and Nike Tennis Crew Socks.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Nike Court Flex Tennis Socks feature a snug fit, arch support, and breathable mesh upper.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Nike Pro Tennis Socks have a compression arch band, cushioned toe and heel, and Dri-FIT fabric.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Nike Dri-FIT Socks are a good general-purpose athletic sock option.
